name: Pixel-Sized Clipmap LOD for Voxels
definition: A level-of-detail strategy where full-resolution voxels are only kept within a pixel-sized radius, with coarser resolutions arranged in concentric clipmap rings.
summary: Pixel-Sized Clipmap LOD for Voxels is a level-of-detail strategy that ties resolution boundaries to the camera's pixel footprint, ensuring finest detail is never over-sampled relative to the screen.
